name: Mota Must Die
source:
In Mota Must Die, a short psychological horror visual novel, you return to a quiet rural hometown alongside childhood friends Sei and Mota. What begins as a nostalgic trip quickly takes a darker turn when an unexpected detour leads somewhere far more deliberate...

“Listen to me… Mota is a murderer.”

Years earlier, Reno’s younger sister Mima was killed in a case that was never solved. Over time, suspicion has quietly settled on Mota... an emotionally distant friend who shared an ambiguous bond with her before her death.

How Do You Live Without Answers?

Reno is a grieving brother who never found closure. What begins as doubt slowly hardens into belief as contradictions surface and pressure builds.

What Really Happened to Mima?

Fragments of memory, emotion, and buried tension begin to surface... Mota’s words reveal something intimate, unsettling...

What Does it Take to Kill?

A decision must be made. Mota must die.  

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533400]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一部短篇心理恐怖视觉小说《Mota Must Die》中，你和儿时好友Sei和Mota一起回到了一个安静的乡村家乡。当一次意想不到的绕道通向更加深思熟虑的地方时，一开始的怀旧之旅很快就陷入了黑暗的转折……

“听我说……莫塔是个杀人犯。”

几年前，雷诺的妹妹米玛在一桩从未侦破的案件中被杀。随着时间的推移，莫塔悄然陷入了怀疑……她是一位感情疏远的朋友，在她去世前与她有着暧昧的联系。

没有答案你如何生活？

雷诺是一位悲伤的兄弟，他从未找到过结局。随着矛盾的浮现和压力的增加，最初的怀疑慢慢变成了信念。

Mima到底发生了什么？

记忆、情感和隐藏的紧张的碎片开始浮出水面……莫塔的话揭示了一些亲密的、令人不安的东西……

需要什么才能杀死？

必须做出决定。莫塔必须死。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533400]Steam[/url]]
